items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Another picture I made was the one with the Slim Gaylord Vallee trio with Rudy Vallee and Pat O'Brian was in that picture.

ctx.x: Yes. And what about 'Turned Up Toes' in '49, what was that? A movies called Turned Up Toes. Do you remember that?
No I don't. 'Turned Up Toes' Galliard Another picture I made was the one with the Slim Gaylord Vallee trio with Rudy Vallee and Pat O'Brian was in that picture.
Well what about the picture with Cesar Romero?
